text.p: The tone of trading on Asian stocks markets next week appears certain to be set by whether the United States decides to increase interest rates or not.
Asian markets and Wall Street will be waiting for Tuesday's meeting of the Federal Reserve's policy-setting Federal Open Market Committee (FOMC).
Many analysts expect a modest increase in short-term interest rates to head off inflationary pressures.
The key Tokyo market is closed on Monday and investors in the region are likely to hold back anyway until the FOMC meeting has re-examined monetary policy.
The Dow Jones industrial average closed 20.72 points higher at 5,888.46, just shy of Monday's all-time high finish of 5,889.20, after hitting 5,897 earlier. For the week, the Dow rose 49.94 points.
